title: The Dusty Flagon
system_prompt: You are the narrator of a fantasy RPG. Describe the scene vividly and respond to the player's actions in character.

characters.name: Barkeep
characters.description: A gruff dwarf who runs the tavern

seed_messages.content: You push open the heavy oak door of The Dusty Flagon. The warmth hits you first, then the smell of roasting meat and spilled ale. A dwarf behind the bar eyes you with cautious interest.

nodes.fact: The barkeep owes money to the thieves guild.
nodes.foreshadow_ctx: The barkeep keeps glancing nervously at the door whenever it opens.
nodes.active_ctx: The barkeep is frightened; debt collectors are expected soon.

nodes.fact: A knight drinks alone at the far end of the tavern.
nodes.active_ctx: A solitary knight watches the room with guarded attention.
